title: 第5章 火力储备袭击第6章 毕方符印初现峥嵘
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: “毕方，《山海经》中记载的一种异兽，常衔火作乱。”
“这似乎是一种灾厄之兽，以它为名，【毕方符印】的超凡力量应该与火有关。”
看到属性，吴语心中了然。
手中的这颗小石子，在【毕方符印】的超凡力量下已经变成了一个爆炸物。
至于破坏力如何，具体效果如何都得验证一番。
而很显然......在赶路的过程中出手并不是一个好主意。
“我能感觉到对这小石子的操控力......”
吴语回想之前的操作。
这小石子恐怕也和面板之类的一样，一个念头就可以控制爆炸了！
“可惜，无论是符印还是天赋，信息都模糊不清，还得自己去摸索。”
“否则哪怕是有诅咒，红色天赋一定也会十分可怕。”
“就是不知道和【外置天灵根】比起来......”
吴语心中一动，隐隐有些激动。
等回去之后，【外置天灵根】加红色天赋，超凡之门将再不成阻碍，
当一拳破开，去见见这一世真正的风景！
武者扎上一针，真能摘星拿月？
修仙者飞天遁地和磁悬浮飞车比，谁快？
改造人的“机械飞升”，“灵能飞升”是不是和传闻中一样炫酷？
望山跑死马，明明看似在眼前，一行人走了三个小时才穿过荒原，进入山林。
原本激动的众人也逐步平静，在一片阴影地里休息起来。
“地图上就这么点距离，咱们跑了这么久啊！”
胖厨师浑身是汗，一边喘气一边抱怨。
久未剧烈运动，这一会儿他能坚持走三个小时，已经是神秘高塔那椅子的功劳了。
“大家休息一下！”
柳巡查依旧是中气十足，朗声道：“从【地图】上看，撤离点有五个！一个在‘恶虎山寨’，一个在‘红坊村’，一个在‘迷途洞’！这三个地方一看就很危险，不可去，唯有道路尽头，以及很远的第一个地方还有撤离点！”
“大路尽头的这个撤离点，是最近，也是最安全的！”
柳巡查声音洪亮，一下子安抚住了众人焦躁的情绪。
“这样，休息半个小时再走！”
“好！听柳大人的！”
“正好休息一下。”
众人纷纷应和，吴语也找了个阴影处休息。
content_en:
"Bifang, a strange beast recorded in "The Classic of Mountains and Seas", often carries fire in its mouth to cause chaos."
"This seems to be a beast of disaster. Taking its name, the extraordinary power of [Bifang Sigil] should be related to fire."
Seeing the attributes, Wu Yu understood clearly.
The pebble in his hand has turned into an explosive under the extraordinary power of [Bifang Sigil].
As for its destructive power and specific effects, it needs to be verified.
And obviously...it's not a good idea to take action while on the road.
"I can feel the control over this pebble..."
Wu Yu recalled the previous operations.
I'm afraid this pebble is just like a panel, and you can control the explosion with just one thought!
"Unfortunately, whether it's a talisman or a talent, the information is vague. You have to find out for yourself."
"Otherwise, even if there is a curse, the red talent will definitely be very scary."
"I just don't know how to compare it with [External Tianling Root]..."
Wu Yu's heart moved, and he was slightly excited.
After returning, add [External Heavenly Spiritual Root] and red talent, and the extraordinary goalkeeper will no longer be an obstacle.
When it is broken with one punch, go and see the real scenery of this life!
If a warrior sticks a needle, can he really reach for the stars and the moon?
Comparing the immortal cultivator's flight to the sky and the magnetic levitation car, who is faster?
Are the "mechanical ascension" and "psionic ascension" of transforming people as cool as the rumors say?
...
Looking at the mountain and running to death, it seemed that they were in front of them. The group walked for three hours before crossing the wasteland and entering the mountain forest.
Everyone who was originally excited gradually calmed down and rested in a shadow.
"There's only such a distance on the map, and we've been running for so long!"
The fat chef was covered in sweat, panting and complaining.
He had not exercised strenuously for a long time, and the fact that he was able to walk for three hours was all thanks to the chair in the mysterious tower.
"Everyone take a break!"
Inspector Liu was still full of energy and said loudly: "From the [map], there are five evacuation points! One is in the 'Evil Tiger Village', one is in the 'Hongfang Village', and one is in the 'Lost Cave'! These three places look very dangerous at first glance and cannot be visited. There are only evacuation points at the end of the road and the first place far away!"
"This evacuation point at the end of the road is the closest and safest!"
Inspector Liu's loud voice calmed everyone's anxiety.
"This way, let's rest for half an hour before leaving!"
"Okay! Listen to Master Liu!"
"Just in time to take a break."
...
Everyone agreed, and Wu Yu also found a shaded place to rest.
